title: veridict input record
description: One JSONL line (or CSV row) for `veridict compare`, `sprt`, or `matrix` legacy per-file mode. Every field is optional at the schema level. The selected metric determines which combination is usable; see README.md#input. At least one of result, baseline+candidate, baseline_status, or candidate_status must be present.

id.description: Used by --paired-by-id to combine up to two records into one metric-specific observation, or by --cluster-by-id as the resampling-cluster key.

baseline.description: Numeric score for mean-diff, sign-test, quantile-diff, or relative-diff. Relative-diff requires a strictly positive baseline.

candidate.description: Numeric score for mean-diff, sign-test, quantile-diff, or relative-diff.
